InstallationConfigurationPluginsFAQ

Installation#

Download the archive for your platform and unpack it into any folder you like. The installer does not require administrator rights and leaves your existing settings untouched.

Configuration#

Lumen reads a single configuration file when it starts. Every option has a sensible default, so a minimal file can be completely empty.

Changes to the file take effect after the next restart.

Plugins#

A plugin is a small folder that contains a manifest and one or more scripts. Place the folder inside the extensions directory and Lumen will discover it automatically at launch.

Frequently asked questions#

Does Lumen send any usage data? No. The application never contacts a server unless you explicitly request an update check.
